panels.title: Average exchange fee per asset
panels.description: Daily average B3 exchange fee unit cost (BRL) per asset, from the Fee Daily Unit Cost (BVBG.044.01) parquet. Each point averages the exchange fee over all of that asset's entries (expirations, trade types, strategy legs) on the trading date. Filtered by the time range and the Asset and Day trade variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, asset, avg(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
  AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
  AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY time, asset

panels.title: Unit cost summary by asset (latest day in range)
panels.description: Per asset and day-trade flag on the most recent trading date in the selected range: number of fee entries, distinct expiration codes, and min / avg / max exchange and registration fee unit costs (BRL). Source is the Fee Daily Unit Cost (BVBG.044.01) parquet, filtered by the Asset and Day trade variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
    AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
)
SELECT asset,
  day_trade,
  count(*) AS entries,
  count(DISTINCT expiration_code) AS expirations,
  min(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS min_exchange_fee,
  avg(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS avg_exchange_fee,
  max(exchange_fee)::DOUBLE AS max_exchange_fee,
  min(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS min_registration_fee,
  avg(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS avg_registration_fee,
  max(registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS max_registration_fee
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY asset, day_trade

panels.title: Largest unit cost changes vs previous day (latest day in range)
panels.description: Top 50 fee entries whose exchange or registration fee unit cost (BRL) changed between the latest trading date in range and the previous date present in the data, ranked by the largest absolute % change. Entries are matched on market, asset, expiration, day trade, trade type, strategy leg and BACEN auction flag; entries missing on either day are not shown, and % change is empty when the previous fee was zero. Filtered by the time range and the Asset and Day trade variables.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
    AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
),
cur AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
),
prv AS (
  SELECT * FROM d WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d WHERE trad_dt < (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d))
)
SELECT c.asset,
  c.expiration_code,
  c.market,
  c.day_trade,
  c.trade_type,
  c.strategy_leg,
  p.exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS prev_exchange_fee,
  c.exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  (c.exchange_fee / nullif(p.exchange_fee, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS exchange_change,
  p.registration_fee::DOUBLE AS prev_registration_fee,
  c.registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee,
  (c.registration_fee / nullif(p.registration_fee, 0) - 1)::DOUBLE AS registration_change
FROM cur c
JOIN prv p
  ON c.market = p.market
  AND c.asset = p.asset
  AND c.expiration_code = p.expiration_code
  AND c.day_trade = p.day_trade
  AND c.trade_type = p.trade_type
  AND c.strategy_leg IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.strategy_leg
  AND c.bacen_auction IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p.bacen_auction
WHERE c.exchange_fee <> p.exchange_fee
  OR c.registration_fee <> p.registration_fee
ORDER BY greatest(abs(coalesce(exchange_change, 0)), abs(coalesce(registration_change, 0))) DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Unit costs (latest day in range)
panels.description: Every fee entry on the most recent trading date in the selected range: asset, expiration, market, day trade, trade type, strategy leg and BACEN auction flag, with exchange fee, registration fee and their sum as total fee (BRL unit costs). Source is the Fee Daily Unit Cost (BVBG.044.01) parquet, filtered by the Asset and Day trade variables; capped at 2000 rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_fee_daily_unit_cost/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ('__all' IN ($asset) OR asset IN ($asset))
    AND ('__all' IN ($day_trade) OR day_trade::VARCHAR IN ($day_trade))
)
SELECT asset,
  expiration_code,
  market,
  day_trade,
  trade_type,
  strategy_leg,
  bacen_auction,
  exchange_fee::DOUBLE AS exchange_fee,
  registration_fee::DOUBLE AS registration_fee,
  (exchange_fee + registration_fee)::DOUBLE AS total_fee
FROM d
WHERE trad_dt = (SELECT max(trad_dt) FROM d)
ORDER BY asset, expiration_code, day_trade, trade_type, strategy_leg
LIMIT 2000
